LWS queues, SLA and maker-checker

A source-linked technical walkthrough. Trace the flow, explain the boundary, then test the failure path.

After this session, you can:
  • Explain derived work
  • Trace assignment and SLA evidence
  • Enforce independence

Technical flow

1. Tasks are derived

LWS projects actionable work from domain state: compliance exceptions, AI review, checker approval, disbursement, collections, NPA review and grievances. Resolving the domain condition resolves the task; a separate task database must not become a competing truth.

2. Work is attributed

Assignment, start, release and comment events retain actor, role, queue and time evidence. Business calendars and SLA policies determine due state.

3. Four eyes

Maker and checker independence is validated against authenticated identity and action history. Committees, overrides and release approvals add purpose-specific authority rather than generic admin bypasses.
